justifications.type_expressiveness: Domain is largely encoded with enums (Expr, BinOp, UnaryOp, Value, EvalError variants), though TypeError carries a String message rather than a structured variant distinguishing operator/operand types.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enums distinguish all required cases, ParseError carries the offset, the library never panics, and the only unwraps are on UTF-8 slices known-valid by construction.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean narrow surface with Display/Debug where required and doc comments on most public items, but Expr/BinOp/UnaryOp/Value lack common derives like Debug/Clone and several public items (variants, BinOp, UnaryOp) are undocumented.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, matches!, and a borrowed linked-list Env avoiding HashMap clones, but the many near-identical expect_* helpers and repetitive apply_binop arms could be more concise.
